scope.description: Review-first enrichment of ten named production records using exact live baselines, concrete technical detail, and durable public evidence.

source.title: Uncrewed Surface Vehicles
source.summary: The official DataXplorer page describes a solar-powered, self-righting uncrewed surface vessel with modular sensor bays, long-endurance operation, and multiple communications paths.

followUpQuestions: Verify the intended payload, endurance, communications coverage, sea-state limits, and cold-weather envelope before treating the platform as a mission fit.
reviewWarnings: Public sources do not establish CAF trials, payload-specific endurance, operation in Arctic icing, procurement eligibility, or operational deployment.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered concrete product specifications and operating context that are absent from the published capability.
Confirmed the canonical organization identity and compared the current public offering to the live record.
Checked for independent deployment and procurement evidence and retained unresolved claims as reviewer unknowns.
